title: Junior Telecom Core network Engineer / Programmer
description:
We're building the next generation of our platform, and alongside our senior specialists, we want to build the next generation of
 *engineers* 
 — people who are early in their telecom career, genuinely curious about how mobile networks work, and disciplined enough to grow into something serious.
 



 If you have 1\\-2 years of experience, or even none at all, but you can show us real curiosity and real discipline — we want to hear from you.
 



  





**Responsibilities** 




**What matters more to us than your CVs** 




 We'd rather hire someone with one year of experience and the right attitude than someone with five years and none of the following:
 


* **You take ownership.** 
 When something is your responsibility, it stays your responsibility until it's actually done — not until it's someone else's problem.
* **You have discipline.** 
 You show up, you follow through, and you do the unglamorous parts of the job as carefully as the interesting parts.
* **You want to be told when you're wrong.** 
 Telecom networks are unforgiving of guesswork. We need people who would rather hear "that's not right, here's why" early than get it wrong in front of a live network later.
* **You're genuinely curious about telecoms.** 
 Not just software. Not just AI. The actual mechanics of how a phone call or a data session works across a mobile network.



  





 You'll work directly alongside our network engineer and NOC/support engineer, learning the real operational side of running a live mobile core network — not from a textbook, but on our actual platform:
 


* **Monitoring** 
 live network health and learning to read the signals before they become problems
* **Learning** 
 to form your own diagnosis of a network fault
 *before* 
 you're shown what our diagnostic tooling suggests — we deliberately train engineers to think for themselves first, not to just read an answer
* **Assisting** 
 with support tickets and learning the discipline of a structured incident response
* **Shadowing** 
 network function commissioning and configuration work
* T
 **aking part** 
 in regular structured learning exercises designed specifically to build real diagnostic judgement over time, not just task completion



  





  





**Qualifications** 




 A degree in telecommunications, electronics, computer science, or engineering . though we care more about what you understand than what's on the certificate

 How You Will Contribute
   

  

 In this position, you will be working with our Clinical Research team. For more information, please visit ITC I Red Nucleus.
   

  

**Job Overview**
 iTakeControl is a clinical trial platform supporting live studies within a validated, GxP\\-compliant environment. We are bringing the platform fully in\\-house and building the team that will own and grow it.
   

  

 We are looking for a strong Backend Developer to own and advance the platform’s server\\-side systems as a hands\\-on, code\\-first contributor. The backend is the most complex and most critical part of the platform — handling authentication and role\\-based access, clinical study data, background processing, integrations, and a substantial server\\-side video and media pipeline — all on live data where stability and integrity carry regulatory weight. Working under the technical direction of the Technical Lead, you will write production\\-quality backend code, keep the system stable and secure, and make sound decisions on a large, established codebase.
   

  

 The nature of this role: this is deep server\\-side engineering, not light API glue. The day\\-to\\-day work is service and data\\-layer design, asynchronous and queue\\-based processing, integrations, performance and memory management, and safe schema changes against a live production database. The platform also has a significant media dimension — server\\-side video processing and video\\-call infrastructure — that this role helps own. We are looking for an engineer who reasons about data integrity, concurrency, and failure modes, not only request/response handlers.
   

  

 This is the foundational engineering seat on the team and works closely with the Technical Lead from day one. It works with US\\-based stakeholders and requires regular overlap with US hours, particularly around releases.
   

  

 What You’ll Own
   

  

* Core APIs and business logic — build and maintain the platform’s server\\-side services and business rules to a production\\-quality standard, with correct authentication and role\\-based authorisation on every path
* Data layer and migrations — design schema and queries against a relational database, and make changes to a live, regulated production database safely and exclusively through reviewed, reversible migrations
* Asynchronous and background processing — job queues, scheduled jobs, and worker pools for long\\-running and CPU\\-intensive work, with correct handling of concurrency, locking, retries, and idempotency
* Video and media pipeline — contribute to the server\\-side video and media systems: video processing and conversion, recording, and the integration that powers video calls (a core, high\\-value part of the platform)
* Integrations and data flows — cloud services (storage, messaging and queues), file handling and uploads, data import/export, ETL jobs, and study\\-configuration syncing
* Security, secrets, and compliance — handle PHI safely, manage secrets through the platform’s secret store, and preserve audit trails, electronic\\-record integrity, and ALCOA\\+ data\\-integrity controls
* Stability, performance, and observability — troubleshoot production issues, manage memory and performance on the running services, and use metrics and structured logging to keep the platform healthy
* Codebase fluency and collaboration — build deep understanding of the existing system during the vendor handover, keep documentation current for the areas you own, take part in code reviews, and align API contracts with the frontend and mobile developers
* You will partner closely with the Technical Lead, who owns technical direction; this role owns the hands\\-on delivery and quality of the backend.


 What We’re Looking For
   

  

 This is a hands\\-on engineering role. We are looking for proven, production backend capability across the areas below — what you can do matters more than titles held.
